scenes.title: 8 tendons, 1 *ring*
scenes.caption: a Bowden cable runs to the servo

caption:
The scan animation was the whole reason I built this.

Each of the 8 shell pieces rides a spring-loaded pin in the core. Eight tendons meet at a ring on the eye axis, and a Bowden cable runs to a servo in the base. The servo winds a spool and the shell pulls shut. Let go and the springs push it open.

180 mm closed, 200 mm open. Files are free, link in bio.
